bootstrap_pairing: same ordered INNER group draws for every available arm, both seeds and mean
missing_slot_rule: retain every registered ID; point, SE and bounds null; status NOT_ESTIMABLE_DEPENDENCY
pair_benefit_convention: control-minus-candidate; negate and swap raw bounds when candidate is registered first
local_worsening_convention: candidate-minus-control; negate and swap raw bounds when control is registered first
utility_convention: candidate-minus-reference for accuracy, NLL and summed multiclass Brier; accuracy lower >= -0.010; NLL upper <= 0.010; Brier upper <= 0.005
privacy_convention: pair benefit lower >= 0.020; each local worsening upper <= 0.010; equality passes
scope: approximate simultaneous development intervals conditional on fitted models/readers; full fixed-K multiplicity despite unrun branches; reused INNER people; no post-selection or population confirmation
reference_eligibility: F, U0 and Ucal are descriptive anchors unless the separately sealed service/input and utility eligibility rules admit a comparison
